content:
It's time to take a look at our hand-picked latest recommendations for iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple has launched its new silicone cases and TechWoven textured case series, featuring color-matched designs, along with our trusted third-party brand favorites. From the new burgundy model with a built-in stand, to ultra-grip customizable models, to premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods — everything you could want is here. We've also found affordable options from value brands like Spigen, with prices starting from just $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Updated 9/27: Added multiple exclusive promo codes for 9to5 readers to use.

Apple

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe – Mulberry: $59
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro TechWoven Case with MagSafe – Light Blue: $59

Featured Partner: ESR

ESR's brand-new iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories collection has arrived, bringing top-tier color-matched craftsmanship, patented technology, and more highlights. The star of this new release is the latest Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic case, equipped with a zinc alloy Flex stand built into the camera bump protection area, offering 3x military-grade protection and a "soft and comfortable grip." Like other accessory lines, the new Atelier is also available in four color-matched options, perfectly complementing the new burgundy, glacier, black, and silver iPhone 18 Pro body colors.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with Flex Stand $42 (originally $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet with Stand (Grip Version) $46 (originally $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

When it comes to leather cases, Nomad is one of the industry's top players, and their flagship models are now fully compatible with the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year they've also launched a new Rugged Case series, with each color engraved with topographic contour patterns from Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Partner: Dbrand

Dbrand is preparing to launch their classic Grip case, compatible with the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to its clean look and ultra-grippy texture, it once again supports a wide range of skin stickers for customization, and you'll get an extra discount when you add a compatible Prism screen protector.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $55 Customizable case, impact protection, ultra-grip, crisp button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) 2-pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Easy installation, auto-alignment, zero dust

This year, Dbrand is also launching a new MNML brand case, priced from just $39, featuring minimalist aesthetics, better value, MagSafe compatibility, and the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Military Blue, Tan, Burgundy

Bluebonnet is a small Texas-based shop that specializes in handcrafted premium full-grain leather cases, featuring a seamless full-wrap design—completely plastic-free—with copper-plated metal buttons. We've also secured an exclusive 20% off deal for 9to5 readers on this new iPhone 18 Pro case:

  • Full-Grain Leather Minimalist iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Case $63 (originally $79) Enter promo code 9to5 at checkout

Burton Goods

***Note: Enter our exclusive promo code 9TO520 at checkout for these cases below to get an additional 20% off the already reduced launch price. If it doesn't work, try entering DUO10.

UAG

UAG has also launched a range of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, including their signature rugged models with reinforced corner protection, grippy frames, and various designs focused on drop protection. If you're looking for a case built for heavy use and everyday protection, UAG's lineup is well worth considering.

  • UAG Mouve $65 (for iPhone Duo)
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 (for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max)
  • UAG Civilian Anti-Slip Case from $60
  • And more...

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you're looking for a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with common brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is worth checking out. These cases pass MIL-STD-810H drop testing, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a more premium case that isn't too bulky for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. They now offer an ultra-thin Aramid fiber case for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, with other recommended models listed below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fiber Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fiber Case $70
  • And more...

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases lean toward more forward-looking designs, featuring futuristic styling, slim profiles, and unique textures that stand out from common cases.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case $60 (for iPhone 18 Pro)
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are perfect for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users looking for slimmer options. Their cases typically use lightweight Aramid fiber, with a clean and minimalist design, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and adding reinforced protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fiber Texture Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Aramid Drop Protection Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox has a range of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases ready, from slim everyday models to rugged durable designs, catering to different protection needs. Many newer models support MagSafe, and some add anti-slip sides, accessory storage, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, so you can choose based on your preferences for thickness and protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more...

Belkin

If you're looking for an iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max case that's cleaner and lighter than full rugged cases, Belkin is a reliable brand. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases, with raised bezels around the screen and camera. Some models like Protect+ add reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2 Compatible MagSafe Anti-Slip Case $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners $60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is another brand that typically jumps to launch new iPhone cases early, and their iPhone 18 Pro series is already on sale with a wide selection. The brand is best known for colorful designs, bold patterns, and protective cases that don't look too tool-like. Most models in the series support MagSafe, with clear, impact-resistant, and more stylish options available.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case $56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case $64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Case with MagSafe $64
  • And more...

Speck

Speck's iPhone 18 Pro series continues the brand's everyday protection style with clean designs. The series includes many slim, anti-slip cases, as well as MagSafe-compatible models and clear designs that let you show off your phone's original color. These cases also provide decent drop protection without making the phone too bulky.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case $50 (for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max)
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case with MagSafe $50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case with MagSafe $40
  • And more...

elago

elago cases lean toward clean, minimalist designs and are more affordable than other options. The lineup typically includes slim silicone, clear, and MagSafe-compatible models in various simple colors that perfectly match Apple's body colors.

  • elago Urban Clear Case $14 (originally $16)
  • elago Pebble Case $15 (originally $17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case $19 (originally $25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case $19
  • And more...
